headline: Library Extends Weeknight Hours
text:
Library Extends Weeknight Hours

Work is expected to begin along the waterfront corridor before the end of the year, weather permitting. The library will extend its hours on weeknights beginning next month, funded by a private grant. The city council approved a new budget on Tuesday, setting aside funds for transit, parks and a long-delayed repair program. Analysts described the decision as a compromise that leaves almost everyone partly satisfied and partly frustrated. Ticket sales have been strong, and organizers say they expect a larger crowd than last year. Officials emphasized that no final decision has been made and that additional hearings will be scheduled. The announcement follows months of quiet negotiations between the agency and neighborhood groups. The forecast calls for rain through the weekend, with a chance of clearing by Monday morning.
